```text
# PR #2958: Patch: Signature only on Full art + Animated, with its own art and motion; Full art offered on a varied set of cards

Closes #2949

## What changed

This applies the owner's answers to #2725's questions 2 and 3, as two new rulings: R2949000 and R2949001.

**Signature needs Full art and Animated (R2949000)**
- **Server.** One function, `cosmetics::signature_fits`, says whether a pick wears both the Full art version and Animated. A pick of `version-full-art`, of `true`, or of a retired full art that implies the version all count as wearing Full art. Animated counts when it is listed or implied.
  - `PUT /api/card-picks`: if `augments` names Signature and the resulting pick does not wear both, each owned and offered, the answer is a 400 and nothing is written.
  - A `PUT` that does not name Signature but leaves a held one without both (for example, turning the version off) drops Signature and writes the rest.
  - The one-time upload (`keepable`) and `freeze_loadout` also drop Signature without both, so the other seat never sees it alone.
- **Client.**
  - `signatureFits` mirrors the server check, and `lookOf` only signs where it holds.
  - `updateCardPicks` drops an unfit Signature on any write.
  - In the Collection, Signature stays listed but waits: it shows "Needs Full art and Animated", is `aria-disabled`, has `data-waits`, and a click writes nothing. A pack reveal's Equip button is hidden for Signature unless the card wears both.
- **The Signature look.** The card's own painter is re-seeded with `artSeedOf(id, "signature")`, so the picture differs from the card's other looks, and the face carries `data-art-picture="signature"` on `.cf-art`.
  - It moves with a new motion, `SIGNATURE_MOTION`, whose particles are silver ink (`--pal-slate-100`). It uses no gold.
  - The image cache is keyed by the seed, so the Animated picture is never served for the Signature look.
  - With the default seed every existing picture is byte-identical, and the golden art tests pass unchanged.
  - The signature over the normal face's art window is removed, CSS rule included.
  - A retired Mythic now shows the Signature look.

**Full art on a varied set of cards (R2949001)**
- An offer clause can now take a `sample`: a seed and a percent. A card is in the sample when the FNV-1a hash of `<seed>/<card id>`, mod `OFFER_SAMPLE_PERCENT_SCALE` (100), is below the percent. The registry check refuses a percent of 0 or 100 and a seed that isn't a slug.
- Full art keeps 60% of its Rare/Epic Units and of its Legendaries/Mythics, plus all 21 full-art cards. That is 157 cards; the smallest set is Meditative+ with 4.
- Signature's offer is exactly Full art ∩ Animated: 155 cards. Animated is unchanged at 239.

**Paperwork:** §14.2 is updated, R2725000–R2725003 each get an "Amended by" line, the paragraphs are in `spec/pending/2949.md`, and a `--visual` pending fragment is added.

## Tests run
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, every result line 0 failed. The only change under `apps/web/src/wire` is the intended `cosmetics.ts`.
- Seeded economy tests all pass on the narrower offer (`cargo test -p jackioh-server`, run before the final edits).
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` all pass.
- `classify --base origin/main --claims` answers "Cards, micro, how cards look changed". With no commits on the branch it can only see "Internal", so I ran it against a throwaway commit of the working tree (`--head`) that moves no branch.
- `vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …` (the harness command): 316 files, 5930 tests pass. Typecheck for web, e2e and component, and eslint on `apps/edge apps/web e2e`, are clean.
- Cypress component specs in Chrome, as the daily run uses:
  - `card-versions`: 4 pass, including the new pixel test. The upper halves of the Full art and Signature pictures differ on 65–87% of sampled points; the floor is 20%.
  - `full-art-finishes` 34, `card-faces` 26, `play-screen` 4, `signature` 2, `animated-art` 2, `full-art-tiers` 5 and `full-art-hand` 1 all pass.

## Decisions the issue left open
- **What counts as wearing Full art.** `true` and a retired full art that implies the version count the same as `version-full-art`. Accepting only the literal id would refuse a full-art card's kept `true` pick.
- **Orphaned Signature.** A `PUT` that doesn't name Signature drops a stale one instead of answering 400, so a stale device's write is never refused.
- **How the offer is narrowed.** A seeded 60% share, not curated rarity clauses, which would land every later version on the same cards.
- **The Signature look's art.** A re-seeded picture plus one shared motion, not a new painter. In the Collection, Signature waits rather than being hidden, so it can still be previewed.
- **The palette constant.** The issue names `RADIANT_GOLD_CLEARANCE`, which doesn't exist. I extended the existing `inRadiantGold` palette test instead.

## Look twice
- **I changed an existing test.** In `full-art-finishes.cy.tsx`, the R2720000 control test failed at 170px on classicplus-019's Mythic, which now shows the Signature look: 1.10% of points differed against a 1% limit. It passes on a clean `origin/main` worktree.

  - I now space the two copies exactly one 256px tile apart (wherever a face fits in a tile). The 1% limit is unchanged and all 34 tests pass. If you'd rather not touch the layout, the alternative is accepting the red control.
- **Not this change, still red.** `src/fx/flavorExits.test.ts` › "#1446 exiled, bounced, crumbled and transformed cues are unchanged" fails the same way on a clean worktree of `origin/main` 443856f94. That was my local run; I have no link to a CI run. The harness excludes `src/fx`, but CI's `web` job runs it.
